purpose: App-wide PaddleLog reference catalog. These are reference paddle models, not user-owned physical paddles.

coverage.upaA: All approved entries in the complete UPA-A snapshot checked 2026-10-02 are represented in the selectable catalog.
coverage.usaPickleball: All approved entries in the complete USAP snapshot checked 2026-10-02 are represented in the selectable catalog.
coverage.important: Snapshot coverage, not a fresh crawl or complete manufacturer specifications. Existing reference identities retained; unsupported cross-list aliases and unspecified variants are not guessed.

sourcePolicy.unknownFields: null/omitted; never inferred except shape/thickness when explicitly encoded in the official model name
sourcePolicy.independentMeasurements: Do not copy third-party lab measurements into PaddleLog without permission/licensing and attribution.
sourcePolicy.approval: Approval is variant-specific and time-sensitive. Re-check governing-body sources for Competition Check.

integration.referenceVsOwned: Reference records must not contain nickname, favorite, lifecycle, maintenance, modifications, sessions, photos, or user measurements.
integration.ownedPaddleLink: A user's physical paddle should reference this catalog by modelId/referenceModelId and store unit-specific measurements/configuration separately.
